text At each step choose a neighbouring vertex uniformly. Choose a destination with probability proportional to its degree. With zero steps assigned when the destination is the starting point, the expected number of steps to reach that destination is Kemeny's constant. It has the same value for every starting vertex.
text weighted average A stationary-distribution-weighted average of hitting times is independent of the starting vertex. The hitting time from a vertex to itself is zero in this convention.
